hero.title: Cycle tracking, quietly done.
hero.subtitle: Lavender calm instead of pink clichés. No ads, no data selling, no pressure. Just your cycle, right inside Telegram.

how.title: Three taps to start
how.subtitle: No signup forms, no email verification. Just open the bot and go.

step1.title: Open the bot
step1.description: Tap the link, Telegram does the rest. No install, no account.

step2.title: Log your cycle
step2.description: Add your last period, symptoms, moods. Takes under a minute.

step3.title: Get insights
step3.description: Predictions, patterns, and gentle reminders — without the noise.

features.title: Everything you need. Nothing you don't.
features.subtitle: The essentials, thoughtfully designed. No upsells, no dark patterns.

calendar.title: Smart calendar
calendar.description: Clear view of periods, ovulation, and fertile windows. Six calm themes.

symptoms.title: Symptom tracking
symptoms.description: Log moods, cramps, sleep, energy. See patterns over time.

partner.title: Partner mode
partner.description: Share what matters with someone you trust. Free, optional, revocable.

safety.title: Safety first
safety.description: Teen-friendly tone. No pushy 'trying to conceive' banners or ads.

trip.title: Travel-aware
trip.description: Jet lag shifts your cycle. Sana adjusts predictions with your trip.

privacy.title: Private by design
privacy.description: We don't sell data. We don't run ads. Your cycle stays yours.

screenshots.title: Calm by default
screenshots.subtitle: Six themes, light and dark mode, every detail considered.

privacy_section.title: Your data stays yours.
privacy_section.subtitle: We built Sana on a simple promise: health data is the most personal kind there is. We treat it that way.

encryption.title: Encrypted end-to-end
encryption.description: Your entries are encrypted in transit and at rest. Only you can read them.

noTracking.title: No tracking, no ads
noTracking.description: No third-party analytics on your cycle data. No ad networks. No 'partners'.

ownership.title: You own it
ownership.description: Export or delete your data any time. One tap, no forms, no 'are you sure' loops.

q1.a: Yes. Core tracking, partner mode, and all six themes are free forever. No paywalls hiding basic features.

q2.q: Do I need to install an app?
q2.a: No. Sana runs inside Telegram as a Mini App. Open the bot, and you're in. A standalone iOS/Android app is on the way.

q3.a: Never. No ad networks, no data brokers, no 'research partners'. Your cycle data is not a product.

q4.a: No. Sana is for anyone with a cycle. Language is inclusive, and we avoid gendered assumptions wherever possible.

q5.a: You share a link with someone you trust. They see only what you choose — cycle day, mood, or nothing at all. You can revoke access any time.

q6.a: Yes. There are no 'trying to conceive' features, no ads, no pressure. The tone is calm and informational, not clinical or infantilizing.

q7.q: Can I export or delete my data?
q7.a: Yes. One tap in settings to export a JSON file. One tap to delete everything — no forms, no waiting, no recovery emails.

q8.a: Premium (coming later) will add deeper insights, advanced analytics, and unlimited history. Everything essential stays free.
